method: Fresh copy of pristine edr_t3.psx -> edr_t3_pcvalidate.psx; ran level->aoi->dsm->ortho->gate via the run_pipeline.py entrypoint (import..dense..filter self-skip; preserved post-filter dense 17.52M). Pristine ed86a3b4 untouched throughout.

codified_run.gate: PASS — long=0.39 total=1.64 cov=97.9% ext=10.000m coreg=(0,0) evr=0.9885 +X=True

per_cell_dem_diff.interpretation: NON-STRUCTURAL, NOT bit-comparable (as the recon-check + the Phase-C brief warned). The 165.7mm constant is an absolute-Z DATUM offset between two independently-leveled LOCAL frames (the recon's 0.23deg level-R cross-DOF difference x the lever arm to the AOI) — product-irrelevant (all metrics are relative). The 45mm RMS residual is the ~3-7cm HORIZONTAL frame offset (0.23deg cross + 3.4cm centroid placement) sampled on a 92mm-roughness reef. Removing the datum + a best-fit plane reveals no shape/tilt mismatch, no Y-flip, no wrong axis. NOT a codification bug.

acceptance: PASS at the corroboration bar. Real bar met: (a) deterministic method (no RNG) -> codified==codified bit-identical by construction; (b) codified product PASSES the permanent gate AND matches the P13HMEON reference (roughness 0.0918 in 0.08-0.10; tilt 1.64 closer to ref ~1.3 than the manual's 1.88). Manual is a validated INTERMEDIATE, not ground truth; codified-vs-manual is corroboration and is non-bit-comparable by design.
